answer: A harbor registry for agent identities should require each agent to stake 500 tokens locked for 30 days before it can earn. Creating a farm of 1,000 fake agents then costs 500,000 tokens locked for a month, while a lone honest agent pays only one stake. A reputation thread tracks each agent's work history, and any identity whose outputs match another's above a 90% similarity threshold is flagged. Verified clones lose 50% of their stake to slashing, and the remaining ember of their reputation is burned, so the farm's profit dies before it can be spent.
